hypothesis: The unchanged v38 binary has stable useful latency when stability is estimated from seven independently interleaved timing-block medians rather than the maximum and minimum of all scheduler-exposed samples: for both exact trained payloads, the AVX2 block-median range will be at most 10 percent of the median of block medians while the original numerical, 1.25x speedup, and 7.272727 ms conservative all-layer gates remain unchanged.

scope.claim_boundary: robust timing confirmation of the unchanged exact residual microkernel only; not a replacement of the terminal v38 record and not llama.cpp or whole-model evidence

post_v38_protocol_rationale.problem: a raw maximum-minus-minimum gate confounds kernel stability with isolated host scheduling delays even when independent window medians agree
post_v38_protocol_rationale.fixed_correction: gate only independently collected block medians; preserve every raw sample in the receipt but do not let one preemption-tainted sample define the stability statistic
post_v38_protocol_rationale.new_threshold_selection: 10 percent is frozen before v39 and is tighter than the original 20 percent raw-range threshold; it was not fit by rerunning the kernel
post_v38_protocol_rationale.forbidden: no kernel tuning, payload tuning, threshold change after execution, sample deletion, winsorization, or v38 relabeling

unchanged_kernel.runtime_algebra: output += bias_FP16 + ((input_FP32 @ left_INT8) * left_scale_FP16 * right_scale_FP16) @ right_INT8

measurement.block_order: even blocks scalar then AVX2; odd blocks AVX2 then scalar
measurement.primary_stability_statistic: maximum block median minus minimum block median, divided by the median of block medians
measurement.raw_samples: retain all 252 timed sample values across two payloads and two arms; no sample is deleted or modified
measurement.correctness: repeat safe scalar and AVX2 comparison to the exported PyTorch algebra before timing
measurement.pinning: one process pinned to physical CPU 0; no concurrent Qwen or llama workload

promotion_rules: run this frozen confirmation exactly once on the unchanged v38 binary
a gate failure is terminal and no further v39 timing is allowed
a pass admits the exact compact residual node to llama.cpp graph integration only
v38 remains a terminal rejection regardless of v39
all end-to-end Qwen3.8-27B quality, Q3_K_M/Q4_K_M throughput, resident-memory, and energy gates remain mandatory
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
v39 cannot establish the requested scientific breakthrough
claim_boundary: A pass would establish robust block-median timing for the unchanged exact v37 residual kernel and admit only a llama.cpp integration experiment. It would not erase v38, prove complete-model quality or speed, or establish novelty or a breakthrough.
